title: Say Premyo na Eges
intro: Diad saray mareen a silir na puson debosyonado ed Madibinon, sakey a sagradon sipan so nilukon. Sayan sipan et akasentro ed bilay ya agni nalikna, tan say kasumpalan to et manguman ed andi-anggaan so kurso na espiritual a tawir. Onloob ed misteryo na sakey a kamarerwa ya say sipan to et nan-echo ed andi-anggaan.
clues: Nanayam ak ed sakey a sankaabungan ya kabkabat ed inka-dios to, tan labalabay koy nawalaan na regalo ya mamaapit ed siak ed si Allah.
Nanggawa ak na masimoon a sipan ed Katawan ko nipaakar ed no antoy akaamot ed siak, ya insipan kon iter ko itan a sigpot ed panaglingkor ed Sikato.
Nen sinmabi so panaon na pangiparungtal, say naawat ko et agko inilaloan, balet inmatalek ko so pamaakaran ed Makaamta ed amin.
Inikdan koy anak ko na ngaran ya mangipapanengneng na debosyon, tan kinmerew ak na proteksion parad sikato tan saray kabyangay boleg to manlapud samay nisamba.
Say anak ko et inyan ed sagradon pasen, diad panangasikaso na sakey a propita a nanlapud boleg nen Aaron.
Say anak kon bii et nagmaliw ya kabkabat lapud kalinisan to tan sikatoy pinili nen say amin a bibii, diad saginonor et nagmaliw ya ina na sakey a baleg a propeta, anggaman ag-inmabobon.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say asawa nen Imran
Say ina nen Musa
Say asawa nen Faraon
Say asawa nen Al-Aziz
Say ina nen Isa

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Sakey a sipan ya idedika toy agni nianak ya anak to ed templo
Sakey a subok ed anos legan na andukey a sakit
Sakey a biahe ed arawin bansa nisengeg ed pananisia
Sakey a komprontasyon ed sakey a managpairap ya ari
Sakey a mamilagron probisyon na tagano a nanlapud tawen
trial.answer: Sakey a sipan ya idedika toy agni nianak ya anak to ed templo

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say ugaw ya manngaran na Maryam
Say baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Say balitok a baka
Say bobon na Zamzam
Say biong nen Noe
location.answer: Say ugaw ya manngaran na Maryam

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say anak to et inawat nen Allah tan binmaleg ed silong na panangasikaso na propesiya
Say anak to et nagmaliw a propeta tan akaawat na kasulatan
Say anak to et intagey ed tawen
Say anak to so angipaalagey na sagradon abung
Say anak to so naikdan na baleg a kakabatan tan kayamanan
outcome.answer: Say anak to et inawat nen Allah tan binmaleg ed silong na panangasikaso na propesiya

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
